slides.title: Duolingo FY2025 investor update
slides.subtitle: Results and the 2026 plan, built only from public filings. Illustrative example, not affiliated with Duolingo, Inc. Not investment advice.
slides.author: SoWhat Decks example
slides.notes: Built only from the FY2025 Form 10-K and the Q4 FY2025 and Q4 FY2024 shareholder letters. Every figure is cited on its slide; derived figures show the formula in the speaker notes.

slides.title: Duolingo is trading 2026 bookings growth for user growth, so judge 2026 by DAUs

points.headline: 2025 delivered scale and profit
points.detail: Revenue rose 39% to $1.04B; adjusted EBITDA margin widened from 25.7% to 29.5% (non-GAAP).

points.headline: But user growth slowed sharply
points.detail: DAU growth fell from 51% to 30% and paid subscriber growth from 43% to 28% (Q4 vs Q4).

points.headline: The 2026 plan gives up bookings growth and margin on purpose
points.detail: Guidance: bookings +10% to +12%, adjusted EBITDA margin 25%, over $50M of bookings invested in free users.

points.headline: Cash flow can fund the bet
points.detail: $360M of free cash flow in 2025, $1.04B in cash at year end, and a $400M buyback authorization.

slides.source: Duolingo FY2025 Form 10-K; Q4 FY2025 and Q4 FY2024 shareholder letters (SEC EDGAR). Adjusted EBITDA and free cash flow are non-GAAP.
slides.notes: The answer first; the rest of the deck is the proof. Slide 12 turns it into three metrics to track.

slides.title: Revenue grew 39% to $1.04B in 2025, the first year above $1B
takeaways: Growth was 41% in 2024 and 39% in 2025: the top line barely slowed
Revenue has nearly doubled in two years, from $531M to $1,038M
slides.source: Duolingo Form 10-K FY2025, revenue (SEC XBRL company facts). Growth: 748.0 / 531.1 - 1 and 1,037.6 / 748.0 - 1.
slides.notes: Revenue growth 40.8% in FY2024 and 38.7% in FY2025 (the letters round to 41% and 39%).

slides.title: Operating margin rose from 8.4% to 13.1%, and adjusted EBITDA margin reached 29.5%
takeaways: Operating income went from a $13M loss in 2023 to $136M in 2025
Adjusted EBITDA margin (non-GAAP) rose from 25.7% to 29.5%; the letters used here do not give FY2023
slides.source: Form 10-K FY2025 (operating income / revenue, SEC XBRL); Q4 FY2025 shareholder letter (adjusted EBITDA, non-GAAP).
slides.notes: Operating margin = operating income / revenue: -13.3 / 531.1, 62.6 / 748.0, 135.6 / 1,037.6. Adjusted EBITDA is non-GAAP: $191.9M in FY2024, $305.9M in FY2025.

slides.title: A one-time $257M tax benefit makes up most of 2025's $414M net income
takeaways: 62% of 2025 net income came from releasing a tax valuation allowance
Without it, net income was about $157M, still up from $89M in 2024
Read 2025 profit through operating margin, not net income
slides.source: Form 10-K FY2025 (net income, SEC XBRL); Q4 FY2025 shareholder letter ($256.7M one-time benefit). Rest = 414.1 - 256.7, not a company-reported figure.
slides.notes: FY2024 shows no comparable one-time benefit: income tax was an expense of $13.7M (10-K). 256.7 / 414.1 = 62%.

slides.title: User growth slowed in 2025: DAUs grew 30% after 51%, and MAUs 14% after 32%

exhibit.title: Growth vs the prior year's fourth quarter, %

takeaways: Every user metric grew more slowly in 2025 than in 2024
Q4 2025 base: 52.7M DAUs, 133.1M MAUs, 12.2M paid subscribers
DAUs feed future subscribers, so this is the number the 2026 plan targets
slides.source: Duolingo shareholder letters, Q4 FY2025 and Q4 FY2024 (SEC EDGAR).
slides.notes: This is the complication: the engine behind revenue is slowing.

slides.title: Engagement still deepened: 40% of monthly users now open the app daily, up from 35%

exhibit.title: Daily active users as a share of monthly active users, Q4, %

takeaways: Fewer new users arrived, but the ones who stayed used the app more often
Daily habit is what converts free users into subscribers
slides.source: Duolingo shareholder letters, Q4 FY2025 and Q4 FY2024. Ratio = DAUs / MAUs: 40.5 / 116.7 and 52.7 / 133.1.

slides.title: Paid subscribers grew 28% to 12.2M, slower than the 43% of a year earlier

exhibit.title: Paid subscribers at quarter end, M

takeaways: The paid share of monthly users still rose, from 8.1% to 9.2%
Monetization of the base improves even as the base grows more slowly
slides.source: Duolingo shareholder letters, Q4 FY2025 and Q4 FY2024. Paid share = paid subscribers / MAUs: 9.5 / 116.7 and 12.2 / 133.1.
slides.notes: Growth rates as printed in the letters: +43% (Q4 2024), +28% (Q4 2025).

slides.title: 2026 guidance cuts bookings growth to 10-12% by giving up over $50M of bookings to grow free users

exhibit.title: Total bookings growth, year over year, %

takeaways: Guidance: bookings of $1,274M to $1,298M in 2026
Management puts the cost at over $50M of bookings, about 5 points of growth
The money goes into the free user experience to grow users faster
slides.source: Duolingo Q4 FY2025 and Q4 FY2024 shareholder letters. FY2026 bar = guidance midpoint: (1,274 + 1,298) / 2 / 1,158.4 - 1 = 11%.
footnotes: FY2026 is company guidance, not a result.

slides.title: Margins step down in 2026: gross margin to about 69% on AI costs, adjusted EBITDA margin to 25%

exhibit.title: Gross margin, fiscal years and 2026 guidance, %

takeaways: Gross margin was about 72-73% for three years
AI-powered features for all users drive the 2026 step-down
Adjusted EBITDA margin guidance: 25.0%, down from 29.5%
slides.source: Form 10-K FY2025 (gross profit / revenue, SEC XBRL); Q4 FY2025 shareholder letter (2026 outlook: about 71% in Q1, roughly 69% after).
footnotes: Q1 2026 and rest of 2026 are company guidance, not results.

slides.title: $360M of free cash flow and $1.04B in cash can fund the user bet and a $400M buyback

exhibit.title: Cash resources and the buyback authorization, $M

takeaways: Free cash flow rose 36% from $264M in 2024 (non-GAAP)
Operating cash flow was $388M in 2025, up from $286M
The buyback is an authorization; timing is at the company's discretion
slides.source: Form 10-K FY2025 (cash and operating cash flow, SEC XBRL); Q4 FY2025 shareholder letter (free cash flow, non-GAAP; $400M authorization).
slides.notes: The over-$50M of foregone bookings is small next to one year of free cash flow.

slides.title: Judge 2026 by whether DAU growth re-accelerates above 2025's 30%, not by bookings growth

items.action: Track DAU growth against the 30% of Q4 2025
items.detail: The plan only works if user growth speeds up; this is the first number to read in each letter

items.action: Check bookings against the $1,274M to $1,298M guidance
items.detail: Slower bookings growth is planned; a miss below the range is not

items.action: Watch gross margin against the roughly 69% outlook
items.detail: A wider drop would mean the AI cost of serving free users is higher than planned

slides.source: Q4 FY2025 shareholder letter (Q4 2025 DAU growth, 2026 guidance and gross-margin outlook).
slides.notes: 2026 quarterly results are outside this deck's material; compare each 2026 shareholder letter with these three baselines.
